description: Existing scalar environment compatibility surface at Phase 1 rollout, including NODE_EMPTY_WARM_HANDOFF_GRACE_MS already released on main in #2305 (51a0acc90). Do not add new feature runtime tunables here. New bootstrap exceptions require a concrete justification; resource bindings are excluded.

bootstrapExceptions.AGENT_EMAIL_WORKER_NAME: Deploy-generated name of this Worker's own script, emitted by scripts/deploy/sync-wrangler-config.ts only together with the AGENT_EMAIL send binding. The agent email admin setup points the Email Routing rule at it, so it must not be admin-editable: another value would route agent mail to a different Worker.
